title: Edit group properties directly on the canvas.
description: Double-click an address range, region or custom property beside a group name to edit its value, including in VNet and subnet headers.

before.caption: Header properties could not be edited directly

after.caption: Double-click a value to edit it in place

note: Press Enter or click elsewhere to save; Escape cancels. Changes support undo and Save JSON. Group names, dragging and resizing keep their existing behavior.
